### Description of the problem / feature request:

New crash in 5.0.0rc2, which wasn't there in 5.0.0rc1. Probably related to https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/commit/3947c836cf0c966882a1524e40fa8c3721ac5b07 (because of the `MerkelTree` in the stack trace).
